obligations.requirement: Camera and presentation changes do not mutate canonical semantic state or RuntimeScene generation/content.
obligations.oracle: Replay/fixture digest and RuntimeScene structural comparison before and after camera-only actions.
obligations.acceptance: All G3 camera/hit/select tests pass with unchanged canonical digest.
obligations.evidence_required: Reviewer-accessible test output and fixture digest artifact.

obligations.requirement: Direct/incremental render input equals a fresh/full reference plan for all G2 V1 kinds.
obligations.oracle: Independent structural comparison of direct plan/digest and full rebuild plan/digest.
obligations.acceptance: No divergence across required fixture corpus and deterministic replay.
obligations.evidence_required: Machine-readable comparison artifact with first-divergence diagnostics.

obligations.requirement: Headless production Render Core output is deterministic and platform observations satisfy approved tolerance classes.
obligations.oracle: Headless golden plus explicit pixel-tolerance/readback comparison; missing required platform evidence is BLOCKED.
obligations.acceptance: Headless PASS and each required host has its declared build/readback/lifecycle evidence.
obligations.evidence_required: Golden/diff artifacts, host traces, and current G0 workspace report inputs.

obligations.requirement: Render traversal and derived resource observations scale with visible/changed locality, without pulling G5 optimization semantics forward.
obligations.oracle: 100K/500-visible locality counters and bounded working-set observations.
obligations.acceptance: No whole-document traversal in the normal render path; declared budget observations are recorded.

obligations.requirement: Surface/frame/presentation generation mismatches are rejected or deferred deterministically; PresentSubmitted is distinct from Presented.
obligations.oracle: Injected stale-generation and lifecycle transition tests.
obligations.acceptance: All stale/resize/lifecycle negatives pass without exposing mixed generation output.
